project_info.name: AutoTrade Pro
project_info.description: MT5-style automatic trading application with live (mocked) charts, indicators (RSI, Bollinger, MA), market lists, and strategy configurations.

core_principles: Data Density: Optimize for high-information density on mobile viewports. Reduce padding on data lists.
Tabular Numbers: Use monospace fonts for all prices, P&L, and indicators.
Tactical Color: Green/Red for financial movement only. Keep UI neutral (black/white/gray).
Native Feel: Bottom tabs, swipeable list items, floating action buttons.

typography.rules: Never use Inter for numbers. Always use JetBrains Mono or Roboto Mono for digits.

spacing_layout.container: max-w-md mx-auto h-[100dvh] relative bg-[#050505] overflow-hidden flex flex-col

bottom_navigation.style: Fixed bottom, h-16 bg-[#050505]/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-white/10 flex justify-around items-center pb-safe

market_list_item.layout: flex justify-between items-center py-3 border-b border-white/5

chart_area.style: w-full h-[300px] bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-white/10 rounded-lg relative overflow-hidden flex items-end justify-between px-2 pb-4
chart_area.indicators: absolute top-2 left-2 flex gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono text-white/70
chart_area.implementation: Use pure HTML/CSS or Shadcn charts/Recharts to build mocked candlestick bars with green/red backgrounds.

strategy_config.style: Drawer/Modal sliding from bottom or full-screen overlay
strategy_config.inputs: Shadcn-style inputs with dark theme, border-white/10, bg-[#121212]

images.description: Abstract dark mode trading app splash screen background with subtle glowing neon green and red patterns.
Elegant portrait of a young male professional.
Elegant white geometric logo for the trading app.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application as a mobile-first web view simulating an Expo React Native app. Ensure the main container is `max-w-md mx-auto` and takes up `100dvh` to mimic a mobile screen on desktop browsers.
Implement a bottom navigation bar with icons for: Quotes (Markets), Charts, Trade (Positions), History, and Settings/Algo.
Implement the Trading Dashboard showing total balance, equity, margin, and open positions (MOCKED DATA).
Create a robust Strategy Configuration view where users can toggle RSI, Bollinger Bands, and Moving Averages, and set their parameters (period, standard deviation, upper/lower bounds).
Add a global toggle for 'Live vs Simulation' mode in the settings or header.
Mock real-time price changes using `setInterval` in React to make the numbers 'tick' (turn green when price goes up, red when price goes down).
For the Chart, build a highly stylized mocked SVG or CSS flexbox candlestick chart using absolute/relative heights with Red/Green bars.
MANDATORY: Ensure every interactive element (tabs, list items, buttons, inputs) has a `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case format.
